spec.name: Furniture Haunted Portrait
spec.description: A thin wall-mounted vampire portrait in an ornate tarnished-gold frame. Raised corner ornaments and stepped crown details surround a pixel-painted pale face, red eyes and high purple collar. Flat rear, connected construction, no stand.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: thin wall-mounted ornate tarnished gold portrait frame with a painted pale vampire face, red eyes, high purple collar and dark background; pixel-painted face on a flat inset, no floor stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Wall attachment: ALL geometry stays in local z=12..15.75, flat rear at positive Z, decorated front facing negative Z. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
